bans_revocation_check.name: bans_revocation_check
bans_revocation_check.value: ("bans"."revoked_at" is null and "bans"."revoked_by_user_id" is null) or ("bans"."revoked_at" is not null and "bans"."revoked_by_user_id" is not null)

invites_email_normalized_check.name: invites_email_normalized_check
invites_email_normalized_check.value: "invites"."email" is null or ("invites"."email" = lower(btrim("invites"."email")) and char_length("invites"."email") between 3 and 320)

places_slug_format_check.name: places_slug_format_check
places_slug_format_check.value: "places"."slug" = lower("places"."slug") and "places"."slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$' and char_length("places"."slug") between 3 and 80
